about: The right runstop for the Katana (milestone-1 task 57, the owner's answers of Oct 8): a run stop: from the run's pace (about 4.6 m/s on the Hunter) to standing in guard in 7 frames (14 rules frames) and about 0.48 m, the trail foot then the lead stepping to brake, the hips sinking; keyed as legs and hips only (the grip's guard or block plays above them) from the Katana's two-handed guard (katana_guard's first frame), each step lifting its foot 16 cm in place, travelling while up and setting it down in place, so the foot lock never drags a planted foot. All the clips of one kind share its length and travel, so the rules hold one profile per kind. Every frame kept as a key pose: Cascadeur's inbetweening would move planted feet. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
